END) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Madrid'::text)

views.viewdef:
SELECT a.id AS articulo_id,
    TRIM(BOTH FROM COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM o.override_nombre), ''::text), a.nombre)) AS carta_nombre,
    COALESCE(o.override_precio, a.precio_base, r.sale_price) AS precio,
    TRIM(BOTH FROM COALESCE(
        CASE
            WHEN (c.parent_id IS NULL) THEN c.name
            ELSE cp.name
        END, ''::text)) AS category_parent_name,
    TRIM(BOTH FROM COALESCE(
        CASE
            WHEN (c.parent_id IS NULL) THEN NULL::text
            ELSE c.name
        END, ''::text)) AS category_child_name,
    COALESCE(
        CASE
            WHEN (c.parent_id IS NULL) THEN c.sort_order
            ELSE cp.sort_order
        END, 0) AS category_parent_sort_order,
    COALESCE(
        CASE
            WHEN (c.parent_id IS NULL) THEN NULL::integer
            ELSE c.sort_order
        END, 0) AS category_child_sort_order,
    COALESCE(o.sort_order, 0) AS sort_order,
    (NOT COALESCE(o.is_hidden, false)) AS is_carta_active
   FROM (((((map_tpv_receta m
     JOIN bdp_articulos a ON ((a.id = m.articulo_id)))
     JOIN recipes r ON ((r.id = m.recipe_id)))
     LEFT JOIN digital_menu_overrides o ON ((o.articulo_id = a.id)))
     LEFT JOIN categories c ON (((c.id = o.category_id) AND (c.scope = 'menu'::text))))
     LEFT JOIN categories cp ON (((cp.id = c.parent_id) AND (cp.scope = 'menu'::text))));

SELECT id,
    box_id,
    type,
    amount,
    breakdown,
    notes,
    created_at,
    user_id,
    closing_id,
    sum(
        CASE
            WHEN (type = ANY (ARRAY['IN'::text, 'CLOSE_ENTRY'::text])) THEN amount
            WHEN (type = 'OUT'::text) THEN (- amount)
            ELSE (0)::numeric
        END) OVER (PARTITION BY box_id ORDER BY created_at, id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS running_balance
   FROM treasury_log
  WHERE (type = ANY (ARRAY['IN'::text, 'OUT'::text, 'CLOSE_ENTRY'::text, 'ADJUSTMENT'::text, 'SWAP'::text]));

SELECT id,
    user_id,
    clock_in,
    week_id,
    total_hours,
    weekly_limit,
        CASE
            WHEN ((running_total - total_hours) >= (weekly_limit)::numeric) THEN (0)::numeric
            WHEN (running_total > (weekly_limit)::numeric) THEN ((weekly_limit)::numeric - (running_total - total_hours))
            ELSE total_hours
        END AS ordinary_hours,
        CASE
            WHEN ((running_total - total_hours) >= (weekly_limit)::numeric) THEN total_hours
            WHEN (running_total > (weekly_limit)::numeric) THEN (running_total - (weekly_limit)::numeric)
            ELSE (0)::numeric
        END AS extra_hours
   FROM view_daily_accumulated;

SELECT t.id,
    t.user_id,
    t.clock_in,
    t.total_hours,
    p.contracted_hours_weekly AS weekly_limit,
    to_char(t.clock_in, 'IYYY-IW'::text) AS week_id,
    sum(t.total_hours) OVER (PARTITION BY t.user_id, (to_char(t.clock_in, 'IYYY-IW'::text)) ORDER BY t.clock_in) AS running_total
   FROM (time_logs t
     JOIN profiles p ON ((t.user_id = p.id)));

SELECT ws.id,
    ws.user_id,
    ((p.first_name || ' '::text) || p.last_name) AS full_name,
    p.role,
    ws.week_start,
    ws.week_end,
    ws.final_balance AS hours_to_pay,
    ws.is_paid
   FROM (weekly_snapshots ws
     JOIN profiles p ON ((ws.user_id = p.id)))
  WHERE (ws.final_balance > (0)::numeric)
  ORDER BY ws.week_start DESC;

SELECT id,
    movement_type,
    amount,
    concept,
    date,
    created_by,
    sum(
        CASE
            WHEN (movement_type = 'entrada'::text) THEN amount
            ELSE (- amount)
        END) OVER (ORDER BY date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_balance
   FROM manager_ledger ml;

SELECT a.id AS articulo_id,
    a.nombre AS articulo_nombre,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM o.override_nombre), ''::text), a.nombre) AS carta_nombre,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM o.override_nombre_es), ''::text), NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM o.override_nombre), ''::text), a.nombre) AS carta_nombre_es,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM o.override_nombre_ca), ''::text), NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM o.override_nombre), ''::text), a.nombre) AS carta_nombre_ca,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM o.override_nombre_en), ''::text), NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM o.override_nombre), ''::text), a.nombre) AS carta_nombre_en,
    d.id AS departamento_id,
    d.nombre AS departamento_nombre,
    o.category_id,
        CASE
            WHEN (c.parent_id IS NULL) THEN c.id
            ELSE cp.id
        END AS category_parent_id,
        CASE
            WHEN (c.parent_id IS NULL) THEN c.name
            ELSE cp.name
        END AS category_parent_name,
        CASE
            WHEN (c.parent_id IS NULL) THEN c.sort_order
            ELSE cp.sort_order
        END AS category_parent_sort_order,
        CASE
            WHEN (c.parent_id IS NULL) THEN NULL::uuid
            ELSE c.id
        END AS category_child_id,
        CASE
            WHEN (c.parent_id IS NULL) THEN NULL::text
            ELSE c.name
        END AS category_child_name,
        CASE
            WHEN (c.parent_id IS NULL) THEN NULL::integer
            ELSE c.sort_order
        END AS category_child_sort_order,
        CASE
            WHEN (c.parent_id IS NULL) THEN NULL::text
            ELSE c.slug
        END AS category_child_slug,
    r.id AS recipe_id,
    r.name AS recipe_name,
    NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM COALESCE(o.override_descripcion, ''::text)), ''::text), NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM COALESCE(r.presentation, ''::text)), ''::text), NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM COALESCE(r.elaboration, ''::text)), ''::text))), ''::text) AS descripcion,
    COALESCE(o.override_precio, a.precio_base, r.sale_price) AS precio,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM o.override_photo_url), ''::text), r.photo_url) AS photo_url,
    COALESCE(o.carta_photo_scale, 'm'::text) AS carta_photo_scale,
    o.sort_order,
    o.plato_marbella_slot,
    COALESCE(o.plato_marbella_is_menu_price, false) AS plato_marbella_is_menu_price,
    COALESCE(o.plato_marbella_hide_name, false) AS plato_marbella_hide_name,
    COALESCE(o.carta_dual_racion_enabled, false) AS carta_dual_racion_enabled,
    o.override_precio_medio,
    NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM o.carta_racion_entero_es), ''::text) AS carta_racion_entero_es,
    NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM o.carta_racion_entero_ca), ''::text) AS carta_racion_entero_ca,
    NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM o.carta_racion_entero_en), ''::text) AS carta_racion_entero_en,
    NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM o.carta_racion_medio_es), ''::text) AS carta_racion_medio_es,
    NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM o.carta_racion_medio_ca), ''::text) AS carta_racion_medio_ca,
    NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM o.carta_racion_medio_en), ''::text) AS carta_racion_medio_en,
        CASE
            WHEN (NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM cat_parent.cover_photo_url), ''::text) IS NOT NULL) THEN NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM cat_parent.cover_photo_url), ''::text)
            WHEN (cat_parent.cover_articulo_id IS NULL) THEN NULL::text
            ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM o_cov.override_photo_url), ''::text), r_cov.photo_url)
        END AS category_parent_cover_photo_url,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM mco_parent.override_name_es), ''::text),
        CASE
            WHEN (c.parent_id IS NULL) THEN c.name
            ELSE cp.name
        END) AS category_parent_name_es,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM mco_parent.override_name_ca), ''::text),
        CASE
            WHEN (c.parent_id IS NULL) THEN c.name
            ELSE cp.name
        END) AS category_parent_name_ca,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM mco_parent.override_name_en), ''::text),
        CASE
            WHEN (c.parent_id IS NULL) THEN c.name
            ELSE cp.name
        END) AS category_parent_name_en,
        CASE
            WHEN (c.parent_id IS NULL) THEN NULL::text
            ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM mco_child.override_name_es), ''::text), c.name)
        END AS category_child_name_es,
        CASE
            WHEN (c.parent_id IS NULL) THEN NULL::text
            ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM mco_child.override_name_ca), ''::text), c.name)
        END AS category_child_name_ca,
        CASE
            WHEN (c.parent_id IS NULL) THEN NULL::text
            ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM mco_child.override_name_en), ''::text), c.name)
        END AS category_child_name_en,
    (COALESCE(m.factor_porcion, 1.0))::numeric(10,4) AS tpv_factor_porcion
   FROM ((((((((((((map_tpv_receta m
     JOIN bdp_articulos a ON ((a.id = m.articulo_id)))
     JOIN recipes r ON ((r.id = m.recipe_id)))
     LEFT JOIN bdp_departamentos d ON ((d.id = a.departamento_id)))
     LEFT JOIN digital_menu_overrides o ON ((o.articulo_id = a.id)))
     LEFT JOIN categories c ON ((c.id = o.category_id)))
     LEFT JOIN categories cp ON ((cp.id = c.parent_id)))
     LEFT JOIN categories cat_parent ON ((cat_parent.id =
        CASE
            WHEN (c.parent_id IS NULL) THEN c.id
            ELSE cp.id
        END)))
     LEFT JOIN map_tpv_receta m_cov ON ((m_cov.articulo_id = cat_parent.cover_articulo_id)))
     LEFT JOIN recipes r_cov ON ((r_cov.id = m_cov.recipe_id)))
     LEFT JOIN digital_menu_overrides o_cov ON ((o_cov.articulo_id = cat_parent.cover_articulo_id)))
     LEFT JOIN menu_category_overrides mco_parent ON ((mco_parent.category_id =
        CASE
            WHEN (c.parent_id IS NULL) THEN c.id
            ELSE cp.id
        END)))
     LEFT JOIN menu_category_overrides mco_child ON ((mco_child.category_id =
        CASE
            WHEN (c.parent_id IS NULL) THEN NULL::uuid
            ELSE c.id
        END)))
  WHERE (COALESCE(o.is_hidden, false) = false);

SELECT articulo_id,
    carta_nombre,
    carta_nombre_es,
    carta_nombre_ca,
    carta_nombre_en,
    precio,
    photo_url,
    carta_photo_scale,
    sort_order,
    category_parent_id,
    category_parent_name,
    category_parent_sort_order,
    category_child_id,
    category_child_name,
    category_child_sort_order,
    category_child_slug,
    category_parent_cover_photo_url,
    category_parent_name_es,
    category_parent_name_ca,
    category_parent_name_en,
    category_child_name_es,
    category_child_name_ca,
    category_child_name_en,
    recipe_id,
    tpv_factor_porcion,
    plato_marbella_slot,
    plato_marbella_is_menu_price,
    plato_marbella_hide_name,
    carta_dual_racion_enabled,
    override_precio_medio,
    carta_racion_entero_es,
    carta_racion_entero_ca,
    carta_racion_entero_en,
    carta_racion_medio_es,
    carta_racion_medio_ca,
    carta_racion_medio_en
   FROM v_digital_menu_items;
